meta.title: Parallax Index — A study in shifting form
meta.description: A procedural field observed through three changes in view.

hero.title: Shape is a matter of position.
hero.intro: A woven signal turns, separates, and resolves as your point of view changes. Scroll to move through the study.

chapters.label: 01 / Near
chapters.title: A surface becomes a horizon.
chapters.body: At close range, density hides the whole. Small shifts reveal the direction of the weave.

chapters.label: 02 / Across
chapters.title: Distance makes the pattern legible.
chapters.body: The field opens into parallel traces, each carrying a slightly different phase.

chapters.label: 03 / Through
chapters.title: The object is also an interval.
chapters.body: Look past the contour and the gaps begin to describe a second, quieter form.

method.label: Method / Browser study
method.text: One local WebGL program draws the field in real time. Scroll position changes the camera, twist, and separation; no recorded sequence is used.

media.posterAlt: An electric cyan woven contour floating on a deep blue field.
